snippet.title: Gobble Inn - Announcement Trailer! Our new game!
snippet.description:
Gobble Inn is a cosy run-based game! Dig in the chasm for ingredients & keep the inn stocked with tasty food for hungry goblins, lizards & more! 🍲🥰

Support the game on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spiltmilkstudios/gobble-inn?ref=7h0nbt

Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4865300/Gobble_Inn/
